name: Naperol Investments Limited
about: Naperol Investments Limited engages in investment and leasing businesses in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Investment and Trading. It is also involved in trading of chemicals. The company was formerly known as National Peroxide Limited and changed its name to Naperol Investments Limited in December 2023. Naperol Investments Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
